explication: Open Intelligent UI is an interactive-answer chat application: a user asks or selects a starter prompt, the agent answers and chooses text, a structured table, or a sandboxed visualization, and the app streams the result into the conversation. The graph also preserves the documented demo, provider-key, mobile prompt-picking, trip-image, and MCP capabilities. Source evidence is partial; unsampled subsystems are included only where the README or tree supports their existence, and uncertain connections are omitted.
